en: A black-and-white historic postcard view of a waterfront scene with a raised bascule bridge at a lock or canal. A steam-powered passenger boat named "FERN" (partly visible) is in the foreground beside the quay, with people standing on the deck and along the promenade. Other vessels and small boats are visible further along the water. On the quayside, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, bicycles, carriages, and a tall, slender pole or mast can be seen. The image is captioned at the top with the location name.
